item.title: Trump says he’ll enact a 10% global tariff by executive order
item.description: The Supreme Court struck down President Donald Trump’s far-reaching global tariffs in a 6-3 decision on Friday, handing him a stinging loss on an issue crucial to his economic agenda. item.title: Wall Street keeps calm after the Supreme Court strikes down Trump’s tariffs
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) – Wall Street kept calm Friday after the Supreme Court struck down President Donald Trump’s sweeping tariffs, which had triggered panic in financial markets when announced last year, and stocks ticked higher. item.title: Galápagos park releases 158 juvenile hybrid tortoises on Floreana to restore the ecosystem
item.description: FLOREANA ISLAND, Ecuador (AP) — Nearly 150 years after the last giant tortoises were removed from Floreana Island in Ecuador’s Galápagos archipelago, the species made a comeback Friday, when dozens of juvenile hybrids were released to begin restoring the island’s depleted ecosystem. item.title: Notre Dame Rallies to Beat CAK 87-85 in Triple Overtime
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) Notre Dame never gave up in the region tournament semifinals. After falling behind 18-points at halftime, the Irish rallied for an 87-85 win over CAK in triple overtime. The Irish advance to the championship game on Saturday afternoon. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Boyd Buchanan Dunks on Silverdale to Advance to Region Finals
item.description: Chattanooga, TN-(WDEF-TV) Boyd Buchanan threw down a few dunks in the second half to knock off Silverdale 59-48 in the semifinals of their region tournament. The Bucs advance to the region championship game on Saturday evening. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
